example.title: Wells Street Bridge (Allen County Bridge No. 542), Wells Street over Spy Run Creek

brief: Single-span, 88 ft reinforced-concrete arch on a city street, built 1914 on the Melan system (a light latticed steel arch rib cast inside the concrete, visible where the soffit has spalled). A flat segmental arch ring with a projecting archivolt band, earth-filled spandrels, 32.2 ft deck with a 29.9 ft two-lane asphalt roadway and no sidewalks. The concrete railing is a balustrade of short turned balusters between panelled posts, with a solid central panel on each side holding a granite plaque: one lists the year, contractor and engineer, the other the county commissioners and auditor. Residential street with street lights and overhead wires, a wooded creek bottom below.

names.plate: granite plaques: "ERECTED 1914 · HALVORSEN CONSTRUCTION CO. · R. T. MAYNE, ENGINEER" and "COUNTY COMMISSIONERS J. D. BRANT · W. G. SCHULTE · A. J. BLACKWOOD · C. H. BROOKS, AUDITOR"
